lines.speaker: Harlow
lines.text: No — I told you, I cannot be seen to be involved in this.

lines.speaker: Harlow
lines.text: A detective has been asking questions. Someone knows.

lines.speaker: Harlow
lines.text: She said she would handle it. She said the same about Harrington.

lines.speaker: Harlow
lines.text: Doyle was supposed to be the end of this. Not the beginning.

spotted_message: Harlow has seen you. He will be guarded now.
